experiment: btt_curriculum_frontier_v1 (arm F) versus curriculum-off v1 (arm C); observation v1, reward v2, Track 1, 3,072,000 policy transitions per run
authority: docs/rl_frontier_curriculum_m7h_proposal.md revision 2, section 7 (the text is authoritative; this file is its machine-readable registration, read by rl/m7h_analysis.py)
status: registered before any campaign run; applied once at n = 3 and, only through gate 3, once at n = 5; never re-decided
arithmetic: exact rationals (fractions.Fraction); every threshold below is an exact fraction written 'p/q'; the first gate that fires decides; every gate condition is reported

C.seeds_0_2: historical runs/m7g_k/m7g_s{0,1,2}_v1 (reused only while the R1-R3 control check passes for the frozen campaign code); otherwise m7h_c_s{0,1,2} trained in full

F.runs: m7h_f_s{0,1,2}; m7h_f_s{3,4} in the extension only

evaluation_basis.starts: tick 0 only (every evaluation episode must be a tick-0 start; otherwise gate 0)

definitions.k[a][s]: 1 iff at least one of the 200 final episodes is a verified clear (Phase K clear verification: native replay from tick 0 reproduces completion_time_passed and completion_input_tick)
definitions.c[a][s]: verified clears among the 100 final stochastic episodes, divided by 100
definitions.chi[a][s]: 1 iff at least one of the 100 final stochastic episodes has a live step with position_x < -2100 (eval_metrics.first_left_entry is not null)
definitions.x[a][s]: the number of final stochastic episodes with such a step, divided by 100
definitions.T[a][s]: total targets_broken over the final stochastic episodes that are not verified clears, divided by their count; undefined if the count is 0
definitions.phi[a][s]: the number of final stochastic episodes whose end_reason is fall (native_failure)
definitions.S_T: the seeds where T is defined in both arms
definitions.D[s]: T[F][s] - T[C][s] for s in S_T
definitions.Dbar: (sum over s in S_T of D[s]) / |S_T|
definitions.g[s]: 1 iff F's training run of seed s has at least one verified genuine_new_policy_entry (section 4: replayed from tick 0 in a fresh process; exact; no live left step on a prefix row; the first live left step is the recorded one, on a row >= L)
definitions.G: sum over F seeds of g[s]

known_control_values_n3.source: Phase K final evaluations of runs/m7g_k/m7g_s{0,1,2}_v1, re-confirmed by R2/R3 (docs/rl_frontier_curriculum_m7h_gate.md)

any_of: the R1-R3 control check has not passed for the frozen campaign code (or, on the retrain branch, a C run is not verified)
a campaign run is not verified (training verification, curriculum verification of every F run: reset contract, accounting, prefix rows, VecNormalize counts, archive provenance)
an evaluation episode is not a tick-0 start
an archive entry without own-run provenance
a prefix mismatch or prefix precondition failure
a native clear whose clear verification did not run or did not reproduce both clocks (Phase K precedent)

gates.name: clears
gates.response: adopt F; the next milestone targets reliable clears

gates.name: crossings
gates.response: adopt F as the exploration base; next milestone: from crossings to left targets and clears

gates.name: extension
gates.condition: gates 1 and 2 did not fire and (K_F = 1 or X_F = 1)
gates.response: seeds 3 and 4 in both arms (extension), then the n = 5 rule

gates.name: discovered_not_consolidated
gates.condition: gates 1-3 did not fire and G >= discovery_min
gates.response: record it; next: a separately registered consolidation proposal built on F and the agent's own verified discoveries (never the fixtures); no budget extension

gates.name: targets
gates.condition: gates 1-4 did not fire and S_T is not empty

a.condition: D[s] > 0 for every s in S_T and Dbar >= targets_dbar_min and Phi_F - Phi_C <= falls_phi_diff_max
a.response: F preferred on targets and becomes the base; the ceiling stays open

b.condition: D[s] > 0 for every s in S_T and Dbar >= targets_dbar_min and Phi_F - Phi_C > falls_phi_diff_max
b.response: record 'more targets with more falls', not adopted; go to gate 6

c.condition: D[s] < 0 for every s in S_T and Dbar <= targets_dbar_worse
c.response: F worse on targets; the curriculum line stops

gates.name: null
gates.response: record 'no measurable benefit of frontier restarts at 3.072M policy transitions'; no extension; the next step is the user's decision

n5.only_if: the n = 3 decision is gate 3 and the four extension runs are verified

c.condition: K_F >= 1 and K_C >= 1; Delta = mean over the 5 seeds of (c_F - c_C)
c.adopt: Delta >= delta_min and c_F[s] >= c_C[s] for every s -> adopt F (decides)
c.worse: Delta <= -delta_min and c_F[s] <= c_C[s] for every s -> F worse; stop (decides)
c.otherwise: record 'clears in both arms' and continue

d.condition: otherwise, exactly one arm has 1 or 2 clear seeds (the other has none)
d.response: record 'clear not reproduced (k of 5)' and continue

a.response: adopt F as the exploration base

b.response: F worse at the ceiling; stop

c.condition: X_F >= 1 and X_C >= 1; Delta = mean over the 5 seeds of (x_F - x_C)
c.adopt: Delta >= delta_min and x_F[s] >= x_C[s] for every s -> adopt F as the exploration base (decides)
c.worse: Delta <= -delta_min and x_F[s] <= x_C[s] for every s -> F worse at the ceiling; stop (decides)
c.otherwise: record 'crossings in both arms' and continue

d.condition: otherwise, exactly one arm has 1 or 2 crossing seeds (the other has none)
d.response: record 'crossing not reproduced (k of 5)' and continue

gates.name: targets
gates.condition: the same inequalities as gate 5 at n = 3, over S_T within seeds 0-4

inequalities.note: D[s] = 0 in any seed blocks 5(a) and 5(c)

precedence_example: K_F = 1 with X_F = 2 is adopted at gate 2, and the single clear is recorded

extension.trigger: gate 3 at n = 3 only; targets, discovery, left-target breaks and non-final checkpoints never trigger it
extension.budget: 3,072,000 policy transitions per run, the same protocol
extension.precondition: the n = 3 decision 'extension required' is recorded; each run passes the launch gate

reported_never_gating: non-final crossings and left-target breaks at every checkpoint
the training classes other than genuine_new_policy_entry
archive size, eligible cells, the lowest x at y >= 3000, the distribution of L and the prefix cost
no_early_stop: there is no early stop based on results
